description: "Pass paymentMethod and userName parameters in preview dialog print action."
instruction: "Pass paymentMethod and userName parameters to triggerBillPrint inside the preview dialog."
chunks:
"                                         billingViewModel.triggerBillPrint(
                                             billNo = activeOrder?.billNo ?: "NEW",
                                             customerName = customerName,
                                             customerPhone = if (customerPhone.isBlank()) "" else "${selectedDialCode}${customerPhone}",
                                             customerAddress = customerAddress,
                                             orderType = orderType,
                                             items = billingItems,
                                             subtotal = subtotal,
                                             discount = discount,
                                             cgst = cgst,
                                             sgst = sgst,
                                             serviceCharge = serviceCharge,
                                             deliveryCharge = deliveryCharge,
                                             finalTotal = finalTotal,
                                             tableName = selectedTable?.tableName ?: "Direct",
                                             waiterName = selectedWaiter,
                                             preOrderAdvance = advancePaid,
                                             preOrderBalance = remainingBalance,
                                             paymentMethod = paymentMethod,
                                             userName = user?.name ?: user?.username ?: "admin"
                                         )"
